title: The All-Seeing Eye
description: A large, detailed human eye with a reddish-brown iris dominates the center of a surreal composition. The eye is surrounded by interlocking mechanical gears, film reels, and colorful floating letters of the alphabet against a dark purple cosmic background featuring a glowing full moon with text written on its surface.
prompt: Surreal painting of a giant realistic human eye with reddish-brown iris at the center, mechanical film reels and gears attached to the sides, colorful floating 3D letters of the alphabet scattered around, full moon in the dark purple night sky with handwritten text on its surface, cinematic lighting, mysterious atmosphere
